title: Restriction preserves the three cohomology comparison equations
statement: Let I and J be preorders, t : J → I a functor, D : Iᵒᵖ → Scheme a scheme diagram and c a cone on D. Let F_i be abelian étale sheaves on D_i with arbitrary transitions φ_f. Supply a sheaf diagram G on c.pt, pullback identifications eG_i, a cocone L, a degree p, a cohomology diagram H with identifications eH_i, a cocone B with vertex identification eB, and the three compatibility equations hG, hH, hB of [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology-stage-continuity]. Using the concrete restrictions of [lem-weil-pbc-etale-reindex-transition-coherence], whisker c, G, L, H and B along tᵒᵖ or t as appropriate and restrict all identifications by their explicit reflexive equality transports (reindexEtaleDiagram, reindexEtaleCocone, reindexEtalePullbackIso, reindexEtaleCohomologyIso, reindexEtaleVertexIso). Then the three compatibility equations hold for these restricted data. No transition coherence, affineness, finality, limit or colimit property, or continuity hypothesis is required.

source.place: Tag 09YQ (theorem-colimit), agent-written coefficient restriction step in lem-weil-pbc-etale-limit-cohomology-affine-stage; source page https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/09YQ read on 2026-10-12.

proof.text: The restricted G and H maps at f are the original maps at t.map f. The restricted cone has leg c.π.app(op(t.obj j)), and the restricted cocones have the original vertices and legs L.ι.app(t.obj j) and B.ι.app(t.obj j). All identifications and transports are explicit constructions.

Cancel the reflexive transports in reindexEtaleDiagram and reindexEtalePullbackIso. The first restricted equation is hG at t.obj i, t.obj j, t.map f. The cone naturality equality used by upperStarComp agrees with the original one by proof irrelevance.

Cancel the reflexive transports in the coefficient, transition and cohomology identification constructions. The second restricted equation is hH at t.obj i, t.obj j, t.map f, since whiskering does not change those maps.

Cancel the vertex identification and cocone transports. The third restricted equation is precisely hB at t.obj i: both cocone legs and the scheme projection are selected original legs, and the coefficient sheaf is F(t.obj i).

lean.statement:
theorem reindex_etale_comparison_coherence
    {I J : Type u} [Preorder I] [Preorder J]
    (t : J ⥤ I)
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u})
    (c : Cone D)
    (F : ∀ i : I, Sheaf (D.obj (op i)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (φ : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j),
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map f.op)).obj (F i) ⟶ F j)
    (G : I ⥤ Sheaf c.pt.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (eG : ∀ i : I, G.obj i ≅
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op i))).obj (F i))
    (hG : ∀ (i j : I) (f : i ⟶ j), G.map f =
      (eG i).hom ≫
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op j)) (D.map f.op)
          (c.π.app (op i)) (c.w f.op).symm).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op j))).map (φ f) ≫ (eG j).inv)
    (L : Cocone G)
    (p : ℕ)
    (H : I ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (eH : ∀ i : I, H.obj i ≅ AddCommGrpCat.of (Sheaf.H (F i) p))
    (hH : ∀ (i j : I) (f : i ⟶ j), H.map f =
      (eH i).hom ≫ AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (cohomologyMap (D.map f.op) (F i) p) ≫
        AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (Sheaf.H.map (φ f) p) ≫ (eH j).inv)
    (B : Cocone H)
    (eB : B.pt ≅ AddCommGrpCat.of (Sheaf.H L.pt p))
    (hB : ∀ i : I, B.ι.app i ≫ eB.hom =
      (eH i).hom ≫ AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (cohomologyMap (c.π.app (op i)) (F i) p) ≫
        AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (Sheaf.H.map ((eG i).inv ≫ L.ι.app i) p))
    :
    (∀ (i j : J) (f : i ⟶ j), (reindexEtaleDiagram t D c G).map f =
      ((reindexEtalePullbackIso t D c F G eG) i).hom ≫
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ((c.whisker t.op).π.app (op j)) ((t.op ⋙ D).map f.op)
          ((c.whisker t.op).π.app (op i)) ((c.whisker t.op).w f.op).symm).hom.app
        ((reindexEtaleCoefficients t D F) i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ((c.whisker t.op).π.app (op j))).map
        ((reindexEtaleTransitions t D F φ) f) ≫ ((reindexEtalePullbackIso t D c F G eG) j).inv) ∧
    (∀ (i j : J) (f : i ⟶ j), (t ⋙ H).map f =
      ((reindexEtaleCohomologyIso t D F p H eH) i).hom ≫ AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (cohomologyMap
        ((t.op ⋙ D).map f.op) ((reindexEtaleCoefficients t D F) i) p) ≫
        AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (Sheaf.H.map ((reindexEtaleTransitions t D F φ) f) p) ≫
        ((reindexEtaleCohomologyIso t D F p H eH) j).inv) ∧
    (∀ i : J, (B.whisker t).ι.app i ≫ (reindexEtaleVertexIso t D c G L p H B eB).hom =
      ((reindexEtaleCohomologyIso t D F p H eH) i).hom ≫ AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (cohomologyMap
        ((c.whisker t.op).π.app (op i)) ((reindexEtaleCoefficients t D F) i) p) ≫
        AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (Sheaf.H.map (((reindexEtalePullbackIso t D c F G eG) i).inv ≫
        (reindexEtaleCocone t D c G L).ι.app i) p))
